title: Yummy Crispy Kenyan Cabbage Gratin
description: A pungently flavored, crispy cabbage gratin bursting with Taleggio and braised aromatics, perfect for a lazy Sunday Kenyan meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large oven-proof skillet over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add the chopped cabbage and smoked paprika, cooking until the cabbage begins to soften, about 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, cover, and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until cabbage is tender.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake uncovered for 20 minutes to develop a golden top.
Remove the skillet, sprinkle grated Taleggio cheese over the cabbage, and return to oven for an additional 10 minutes until cheese is melted and crisp.
Remove from oven, garnish with chopped parsley, and let rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the gratin into portions and serve hot.
